# velocity, and kinematic distance of the cloud. Columns (6)-(8): mass, effective radius, and

# increments at the smallest lag. Columns (11)-(12): left end and right end of the power-law
# fitting range for the unweighted VSFs. Columns (13)-(15): fitted power-law exponents for the
# first-to-third-order unweighted VSFs. Column (16): category of the unweighted VSF, based on
# the fraction f = (log l2 - log l1) / (log R_eff - log resolution) of the cloud's log-scale
# range [resolution, R_eff] over which the power law holds (l1, l2 = Left, Right):
